title: Daggers+
body:
These are the swords

Ice Sword - Applies slowness for 2 seconds

OP Sword - Does 10000 damage but has 1 durability

Cactus Sword - Damages Yourself when you swing

Bin Sword - Clear all Items in the Targets Inventory

Glowstone Sword - Applies Glowing on your Target

Really Bad Sword - DO NOT HOLD!!!!!!!!!

Lightning Sword - Summons Lightning when clicked on a block 

Crafts in Gallery
